notes.title: Update 12
notes.notes:
- Story mode completed! 150 levels with tons of gifts included.
- New Arena mode. (Work in progress)
- Full suport to OCULUS TOUCH including the level editor.
- Now you can select your own scale playing in VR. The new scale x1 is awesome!
- Great improvement in throttle management.
- Improved the water qualtiy in the VR version.
- More options in the controls screen to improve the support of racing wheels.
- New game trailer.

notes.title: Update 4: Level editor + gravity levels
notes.notes:
Now available the new update with 2 great changes:

1- New levels in the space with low gravity. Cool!

2- New section named "Community levels" where you can edit and play levels created by the community. The edition of the levels At the moment only works in HTC-VIVE. You can check one video about how it works here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HInJ7ul3KpE

notes.title: Update 2
notes.notes:
Just a new update published today
1- Local multiplayer improvement: More tracks and options! 
2- Chinese translation. 
3- Improved the support for external controls playing in VR
4- Fixed the problem with the reverse/break in VIVE. 
5- Other bug fixes and improvements. 

At the end of this week we hope to have another update with a great improvement in the camera system for the no VR version. Thanks for the feedback!

At the end of this week we hope to have another update with the following changes:

2- Big Local multiplayer improvement: More tracks and more options!
3- Chinese translation.
